# coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-flash_10-low-intents

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

Tests **Message Intent Tags** in isolation on `gemini-3-flash-preview` (`low` thinking, 100 steps, compaction at 28K, per-turn step counter) across `flash_10`. Agents tag every outgoing message with an explicit speech-act intent (`Proposal`, `Request`, `Response`, `ACK`, or `FYI`); the receiving harness prioritizes `Request` and `Proposal` messages ahead of `FYI` status updates, surfaces unanswered peer obligations in the turn footer, and checks once before submission that no live peer's `Request` or `Proposal` is left unanswered. Compared directly against `coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-flash_10-low-stepcounter` (6/10 overall, 3/10 clean-merge passes).

## Observations

- Zero agents hit the 100-step limit (down from 1 in baseline, finishing in 10 minutes at `$3.66`) with zero intent-parse errors across 113 messages (`Response`: 15, `FYI`: 12, `ACK`: 10, `Request`: 9, `Proposal`: 3, plus body-prefixed intents).
- Passed 4/10 overall (3 clean merges + 1 conflict-fallback pass on `typst_task/6554`), matching the baseline's 3/10 clean-merge pass rate and notably solving `pillow_task/290` cleanly (`yes/yes/clean`, `$0.54`), a pair that failed on both `gemini-3-flash-preview` and `gemini-3.8-flash` baselines.
- Without boundary-timed delivery, immediate mid-edit `Request`/`Proposal` injections still coincided with 5 merge conflicts across the 10 pairs (`dottxt_ai_outlines_task/1655`, `dspy_task/8394`, `go_chi_task/26`, `pallets_click_task/2800`, `typst_task/6554`).
